caseNameFull: Enterprise Box Co. v. Holland, Administrator
attorneys: Mr. Martin Caraballo for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. Warner W. Gardner for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion to substitute L. Metcalfe Walling, present Administrator of the Wage and Hour Division, U. S. Department of Labor, in the place and stead of Thomas W. Holland is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
